notes: Taxa the passes are compared at. Within a group no pass has shown on recordings of known species that it can tell the members apart: BattyBirdNET swaps P. nathusii and P. kuhlii at full confidence and takes V. murinus for a noctule, BatDetect2 has no class for three of them. So two passes naming different members of one group agree, and no pass may narrow a group to one of its members. Taxa in no group are compared as themselves.
